creator: Claude
name: Mirrored Medicine Cabinet
source_format: MagicaVoxel VOX v150 (SIZE, XYZI, RGBA), single model

derived.glb_note: Derived from the .vox by tools/claude/export_glb.py; do not edit by hand. Linear COLOR_0 vertex colours, one material.

resolution_rationale: 5 cm cells (the library's furniture/prop tier): real member thicknesses (boards, rails, cushions, doors) stay believable instead of toy-like; matches the game's 0.05 m character rig.
godot_mapping: godot = ((vx - px) * s, (vz - pz) * s, -(vy - py) * s)
pivot_note: Bottom centre of the back face (the cabinet body, not the open door). Hang with the back on the wall; bottom at about 1.20 m (over a 0.85 m vanity).
front_note: +Y faces into the room; the back (y = 0) is flat for the wall.
dimensions_note: Occupied extents of the voxel grid (X width, Y depth, Z height).
palette: Shared Claude palette v2 (tools/claude/voxkit.py); one material family per 8-swatch row in MagicaVoxel's palette grid.
collision_hint: Box 0.65 x 0.20 x 0.75 m for the body; the open door adds a 0.05 x 0.30 m leaf at the right end.
story: The bathroom cabinet was the first thing searched. Someone swept the shelves into a bag and left the right door hanging open; only an amber pill bottle and a plastic bottle that rolled to the back were left. Damp has started to lift the mirror silver along its bottom edge.
notes: Closed body 0.65 x 0.20 x 0.75 m (GPT reference 0.65 x 0.22 x 0.74 m); the open right door adds 0.30 m of depth.
